title: 6-round AES-192/256 partial-subkey recovery with shifting retracing boomerang

target.description: Initial AddRoundKey k_-1 followed by 6 AES rounds, with final MixColumns omitted. The algorithm recovers the 128-bit initial subkey k_-1. For the standard 192-/256-bit master keys this is a partial-key target; completing the remaining master-key material is outside the reported budget.

setting.key_relation: One unknown secret key with encryption and decryption oracle access; no related-key oracle.
setting.key_population: general secret key; no weak-key restriction reported
setting.plaintext_model: 2^20 chosen plaintexts varying bytes 0,5,10,15; eight adaptive ciphertext modifications for each plaintext and each 32-bit last-round-subkey guess
assumptions: The source's Section 4.1 explicitly makes the attack descriptions independent of the AES key schedule.
Costs and probability estimates follow the journal version's statistical assumptions; Appendix A.5 identifies rigorous probability analysis as further work.
Algorithm 6 also guesses four final-round-subkey bytes; no full-master-key completion budget for AES-192 or AES-256 is supplied.

data.note: Dominant decryption budget 2^20*8*2^32=2^55; the initial 2^20 encryptions are additional.

success.description: The source expects two useful pairs and calls recovery high-probability, but does not give a numerical aggregate probability. The existing output-coordinate/friend-condition conflict remains unresolved. The stated wrong-pair filtering probability is retained only as a conditional component of the author model.

field_conflicts.label: Algorithm6 output-difference/shift condition
field_conflicts.description: Algorithm6 line9 retains equality of the first output byte, excluding every prescribed shift with nonzero first byte. At the stated E12L super-S-box coordinates, a nonzero inverse-column input propagates through the two-round component to nonzero input in every super-S-box (for r=1..4 active bytes), so the whole-zero output branch is unavailable there. An independent5000-case local check includes an explicit r=3 witness retained by the byte filter but producing no common shifted friend. Resolve final-layer coordinate absorption and line17 shifted/inverse-shifted wording before extending this local result to the whole six-round attack. Published D55/M31/T80 retained.
